description: Linaria is founded on the premise that no pioneer should be forgotten; it seeks to give a voice to the machines that now rest in the solitude of the Moon and Mars. The project aims to craft an accessible and moving narrative about these technological monuments—which led to major discoveries—and the solitary journey through which these tools brought humanity closer to the cosmos.
summary:
The project Where Explorers Rest tells the stories of space probes, rovers, and equipment that, after completing their missions, remained on other worlds or continued traveling through deep space. Through an illustrated narrative for young audiences, readers discover these silent explorers and their contributions to space exploration.
Guided by Linaria, the journey explores the Moon, Mars, and distant regions of the Solar System, revealing technological achievements and the human stories behind each mission. The book aims to inspire scientific curiosity and celebrate humanity's desire to explore and understand the unknown.
details:
Introduction

Space exploration is marked by great discoveries, technological advancements, and missions that have expanded our understanding of the Universe. Throughout this journey, numerous machines have been sent to explore other worlds, collect information, and reach distant regions of the Solar System.

However, not all of them remain operational. Some rest on the surfaces of the Moon and Mars, others completed their missions in the depths of giant planets, while some continue traveling through space, even after decades of activity.

Where Explorers Rest is an illustrated book that brings these stories back to life, introducing young readers to the machines that have shaped space exploration and the scientific legacy they have left for humanity.

Objectives

The main objective of this project is to bring young audiences closer to the history of space exploration, inspiring curiosity about the technologies, missions, and discoveries that have contributed to our understanding of the Solar System.

Specific objectives include:

  • Introducing probes, landers, rovers, and other equipment used in space exploration.
  • Explaining, in a simple and accessible way, the scientific importance of these missions.
  • Highlighting the legacy of equipment that has ceased operating or remains in distant locations.
  • Encouraging interest in astronomy, technology, and scientific research.
  • Demonstrating that even after a mission ends, its discoveries continue to contribute to human knowledge.

Development

The project was developed as an illustrated book, organized into chapters that follow different stages of space exploration.

The narrative begins on the Moon, moves on to the machines that explored Mars, and continues with missions that met their final destinations on planets such as Jupiter, Saturn, and Mercury. It then introduces probes that continue traveling through the most distant regions of the Solar System.

Among the explorers featured are the modules and instruments from the Apollo missions, the Viking landers, the Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity rovers, as well as the Cassini, Galileo, MESSENGER, Pioneer, and Voyager probes.

The book uses an educational and narrative approach, guided by the character Linaria, who accompanies readers throughout the journey and introduces the stories of each explorer. Scientific information is based on official NASA materials and records, while the illustrations and visual identity were designed to convey a science fiction atmosphere inspired by the aesthetics of the 1960s.

Impact

The project seeks to transform scientific information into a more engaging, visual, and accessible reading experience for young audiences.

By presenting space missions through stories, illustrations, and accessible explanations, the book aims to encourage scientific curiosity and demonstrate that space exploration is about more than astronauts and major discoveries.

Every piece of equipment sent into space represents years of research, planning, and human effort. Even those that no longer function remain part of scientific history, as the data they collected helps us better understand planets, moons, and the very origins of the Solar System.

In this way, the project also seeks to highlight engineering, scientific research, and collaboration across different fields of knowledge.

Conclusion

Throughout history, machines built by humanity have traveled vast distances to explore places we once knew very little about. Some have remained on distant worlds; others have disappeared into the depths of planets or continued their journeys toward interstellar space.

Although many of these missions have come to an end, their contributions remain. Every transmitted image, every measurement taken, and every discovery represents an important step in humanity's attempt to understand the Universe.

Where Explorers Rest is, above all, a tribute to these silent explorers and to the people who made their journeys possible. After all, a mission may end, but the knowledge it leaves behind continues to travel.

Use of Artificial Intelligence

Artificial intelligence was used as a supporting tool throughout the development of this project, contributing to the organization of ideas, the drafting and revision of texts, and the creation of visual concepts for the character Linaria and the book's illustrative identity.

AI tools assisted in the creative process, particularly in developing an aesthetic inspired by 1960s science fiction and in visually representing the journey through space.
